items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Little dad, yeah. Well, he used to play, uh, banjo.

ctx.x: Yeah, he used to play harmonica and then clarinet.

He was playing clarinet. He still plays harmonica. Oh, he used to play too. Boy on bass, we called him T-boy. Little fella by the name of Freddie, he was playing carnet. And a little bit of short fella, about that high, called him Dad. He was playing Bouncy. Oh yeah, he just died, I think, last year.
Yeah, I didn't know he was dead. Yeah, yeah, he died.
